description: Source file implementing Mojo decoder buffer conversion, including creation of data pipes, reading and writing decoder buffers via Mojo IPC, and handling pipe events.

classes.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader
classes.description: Handles reading decoder buffers from a Mojo data pipe, managing asynchronous pipe events, and buffering read data.

classes.name: MojoDecoderBufferWriter
classes.description: Handles writing decoder buffers into a Mojo data pipe, managing asynchronous pipe events, and buffering write data.

methods.name: CreateDataPipe
methods.description: Creates a Mojo data pipe with specified capacity, setting producer and consumer handles.

methods.name: GetDefaultDecoderBufferConverterCapacity
methods.description: Returns default capacity for decoder buffer conversion based on stream type (audio/video).

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::Create
methods.description: Creates a MojoDecoderBufferReader with a specified capacity and producer handle.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::ReadDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Queues a decoder buffer for reading from the Mojo data pipe.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::Flush
methods.description: Flushes pending read operations, invoking callback when complete.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferReader::HasPendingReads
methods.description: Checks if there are pending read operations.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferBufferWriter::Create
methods.description: Creates a MojoDecoderBufferWriter with a specified capacity and consumer handle.

methods.name: MojoDecoderBufferWriter::WriteDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Queues a decoder buffer for writing into the Mojo data pipe.
